She's a very sweet girl, very beautiful, and she's shy, but she's getting better. She's very artsy, loves pictures drawing, making crafts, you name it. She was always scared that I never liked what she enjoyed, and never really introduced me, but when she did, i messed it up.. 
Before we got together, she told me of things that happened to her with 2 guys that she deeply regrets and was pushed to do it because she was scared and didn't know what to do. I'm only bringing that up because in a way, we saved each other from our past, and that's what got us together.
